sources.title: Supported AI models - Kore.ai Docs
sources.snippet: Agent Platform supports a wide range of AI models across multiple providers, allowing you to switch models without changing your agent architecture. Supported models include LLMs, embedding models, audio models, and realtime models. The supported models list includes the provider name, model name, and model identifier used for configuration.
